title: Copper vs Pex vs SharkBite - Freeze Testing
summary: Builder Matt Risinger freezes water-filled copper and PEX piping capped with SharkBite fittings to see which survives. The video compares how each pipe type handles freezing.
why: Recommended as an interesting experiment showing PEX tolerates freezing better than copper.

quote.text: did a freeze comparison between copper, pex, and sharkbite fittings some time back. It was pretty interesting.
